Item.text:
Your Aras subscription has expired. Only the following users can log in to Aras Innovator to activate the feature license: root, admin, or the user defined in InnovatorServerConfig.xml.
To activate the feature license: 1) Log in to Aras Innovator. 2) From the User menu (top-right corner), select Activate Feature. 3) Enter a valid license key and click Activate. 4) Verify the activation under Licensing → Dashboard.
